title: TIREseq - Turbocapture Integrated RNA Expression Sequencing
author: Daniel V Brown
materials: Thaw frozen buffers and primers on ice
Thaw the cell lysates On ice

Keep half the sample at -20 °C as a backup. Prepare the following random hexamer master mix: A B C 1 Reagent 1 rxn 4 rxn + 10% 2 10x NEB buffer 3.1 2 8.8 3 100uM TIRE hexamer primer 2 8.8 4 10mM dNTPs 2 8.8 5 Linear amp product 13 6 Total 19 83.6

steps.title: Prepare Workspace and Reagents
steps.instruction: Prepare the laboratory environment and necessary stock solutions.

substeps.instruction: Clean all surfaces and pipettes with PCR clean wipes.
Turn on one lab oven to 50 °C and another to 80 °C.
Prepare fresh 80% EtOH.
Prepare TCL lysis buffer (maximum concentration 2,000 cells per µL to avoid excessive viscosity from genomic DNA).

steps.title: Prepare Cell Lysate
steps.instruction: Lysis of adherent or suspension cells using TCL buffer.

substeps.instruction: For adherent cells: Prepare 1x TCL to cover the culture dish surface; add 1% v/v 2-Mercaptoethanol. Remove culture media by vacuum, wash with 1 volume of PBS, remove PBS, and add the relevant volume of 1x TCL buffer. Homogenize lysate using a cell scraper and p1000 pipette.

For suspension cells: Prepare an equal volume of 2x TCL as the cell culture media volume; add 1% v/v 2-Mercaptoethanol. Add the relevant volume of 2x TCL buffer directly to culture media and homogenize with a p1000 pipette.
Optional: Store lysate at -80 °C for up to 6 months.

steps.title: Capture RNA
steps.instruction: Bind RNA to the TurboCapture plate and wash.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 20 µL of cell lysate to a TurboCapture plate (max 80 µL, but note that Kappa HiFi polymerase volume must match this in a later step). Avoid bubbles/foam.
Cover the plate with a plastic seal and incubate on a laboratory rocker at room temperature for 1 hour.
Remove liquid from the plate by flicking over a sink (ELISA flicking technique) while running the tap.
Wash the plate 3 times using 100 µL Buffer TCW per well, flicking out the buffer after each wash.

steps.title: Reverse Transcription
steps.instruction: Perform reverse transcription on the captured RNA.

substeps.instruction: Prepare the reverse transcriptase mixture (per 1 rxn: 4 µL 5x Maxima buffer, 0.2 µL 100mM dNTPs, 0.2 µL 100µM TIRE_TSO, 0.2 µL 20U/uL SuperaseIN, 2 µL 200U/uL Maxima reverse transcriptase, and 13.4 µL Water; Total 20 µL).
Remove all Buffer TCW from the plate via pulse centrifugation and aspiration with a multichannel pipette.
Add 20 µL of the reverse transcription mix to each well.
Incubate in a thermocycler: 50 °C for 1 hour, then 80 °C for 10 min, then hold at 4 °C.

steps.title: Remove Reverse Transcriptase
steps.instruction: Degrade/remove the reverse transcriptase and wash the plate.

substeps.instruction: Add 150 µL 100 mM NaOH to the plate and immediately flick out the liquid.
Add 100 µL 100 mM NaOH and incubate for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Wash the plate 2 times with 150 µL 10 mM Tris pH 7.5, flicking out the liquid after each wash.
Remove all residual Tris buffer via pulse centrifugation and aspiration with a multichannel pipette.

steps.title: Linear Amplification
steps.instruction: Perform linear amplification of the cDNA.

substeps.instruction: Dispense 10 µL 2x Kappa HiFi Polymerase into each well.
Dispense 10 µL 1 µM barcoding primer into each well and mix well.

Incubate in a thermocycler: Initial denaturation 98 °C for 2 min (1 cycle); then 10 cycles of 98 °C for 20 sec, 60 °C for 30 sec, and 72 °C for 30 sec; Final elongation 72 °C for 2 min (1 cycle); Hold.

steps.title: First SPRI Bead Cleanup
steps.instruction: Pool samples and perform a 1.2x SPRI cleanup.

substeps.instruction: Prepare SPRI beads by diluting SPRIselect beads 1:4 in SPRI buffer (2.5 mL diluted beads per 96-well plate).
Pool all wells into a single tube (e.g., via SBS reservoir or multichannel pipette), mix well, and distribute across four 1.5 mL Eppendorf tubes.
Perform a 1.2x SPRI cleanup (e.g., 540 µL diluted beads for 450 µL sample).
Incubate at room temperature for 5 minutes, then on a magnet for 5 minutes.
Remove supernatant and add 500 µL 80% ethanol. Repeat for a total of 2 ethanol washes.
Pulse centrifuge and remove residual ethanol.
Incubate on the magnet for 2 minutes.
Elute with 30 µL water. Transfer 28 µL of each of the 4 aliquots into separate 0.2 mL strip tubes (can be stored at -20 °C).
Add random hexamer mix to samples and incubate at 95 °C for 2 min.
Cool to room temperature, then add 1 µL Large (Klenow) Fragment and mix well.
Incubate at 25 °C for 30 min, then at 75 °C for 20 min.
Perform a 1.8x SPRI bead cleanup using undiluted beads (following the general cleanup protocol).
Elute in 20 µL water in a 0.2 mL strip tube.

steps.title: PCR1 Amplification
steps.instruction: Perform the first round of PCR.

substeps.instruction: Prepare PCR1 master mix for each of the 4 aliquots (per 1 rxn: 20 µL purified Klenow reaction, 25 µL 2x Kappa HiFi polymerase, 5 µL 10µM TIRE PCR1 primer premix; Total 50 µL).
Add 30 µL PCR1 master mix to each purified Klenow reaction.
Run PCR: Use 10 cycles for 1M-10M cells, or 12 cycles for 100,000 cells.
Perform a 1x SPRI bead cleanup using undiluted beads.
Elute in 15 µL EB and transfer 13 µL to a new tube.

steps.title: PCR2 Amplification
steps.instruction: Perform the second round of PCR.

substeps.instruction: Prepare PCR2 master mix for each of the 4 aliquots from the PCR1 reaction.
Run PCR: Use 8 cycles for 1M-10M cells, or 10 cycles for 100,000 cells.

steps.title: Double-Sided SPRI Size Selection
steps.instruction: Perform size selection to obtain Illumina-compatible fragments.

substeps.instruction: Combine all 4 aliquots into a single tube (~100 µL crude PCR2 product).
Add 50 µL (0.5x) undiluted SPRI beads, incubate at room temperature for 5 min, then on a magnet for 5 min.
Transfer the supernatant to a new 1.5 mL tube (discard beads).
Add 25 µL (0.8x) undiluted SPRI beads and incubate off magnet for 5 min.
Transfer to magnet and incubate for 5 min.
Remove supernatant. Add 500 µL 80% ethanol while on the magnet. Repeat for a total of 2 ethanol washes.
Pulse centrifuge, then incubate on magnet with cap open for 2 minutes.
Elute in 27 µL EB and transfer 25 µL to a new tube as the finished library.

steps.title: Library Quantification and Sequencing
steps.instruction: Quantify the library and sequence on an Illumina platform.

substeps.instruction: Quantify final library using Qubit DNA high sensitivity kit (expected concentration: 1-20 ng/µL).
Sequence with the following requirements: Read 1 (50nt), Index 1 (8nt), Index 2 (8nt), Read 2 (72nt).
Target approximately 2 million reads per well (~200M reads per 96-well plate).
